title: Mushroom Ravioli with Cream Sauce
description: Mushroom Ravioli with Cream Sauce is a gourmet Italian pasta dish featuring delicate handmade ravioli filled with a rich blend of mushrooms, Parmesan, and fresh herbs. Finished with a silky cream sauce infused with white wine and Parmesan, this elegant restaurant-quality recipe delivers luxurious flavors and a beautifully balanced texture.

ingredients.title: For the Pasta Dough (yields ~4 servings)
items: 200g (1 2/3 cup) all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting

ingredients.title: For the Mushroom Filling
items: 300g mixed mushrooms (cremini, shiitake, porcini), finely chopped
Salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.title: For the Cream Sauce
items: Salt and white pepper to taste

instruction.title: Step 1 – Make the Pasta Dough
steps: On a clean surface, mound the flour and make a well in the center.
Crack eggs into the well, add olive oil and salt.
Gradually mix flour into the eggs with a fork, then knead until smooth and elastic (8–10 min).
Wrap in plastic wrap, rest for 30 minutes at room temperature.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Mushroom Filling
steps: Heat butter and olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Sauté shallot and garlic until translucent.
Add mushrooms and thyme; cook until liquid evaporates and mushrooms are caramelized (~8 min).
Stir in heavy cream and Parmesan, season with salt and pepper. Cool completely before using.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Roll and Fill the Ravioli
steps: Roll pasta thinly (2mm) using a pasta machine or rolling pin.
Place teaspoons of mushroom filling about 2 inches apart on one sheet.
Brush edges with water, lay another sheet on top, and press around filling to seal.
Cut into squares or circles, press edges with fork for a clean seal.
Dust with flour to prevent sticking.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Cook the Ravioli
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle boil.
Cook ravioli in batches for 3–4 minutes or until al dente.
Drain carefully and set aside.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Make the Cream Sauce
steps: In a pan, melt butter over medium heat. Sauté shallot until soft.
Deglaze with white wine, simmer until reduced by half.
Add heavy cream and Parmesan, simmer until thickened (2–3 min).
Season with salt and white pepper.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Plate the Dish
steps: Spoon sauce onto the plate.
Place ravioli neatly on top.
Drizzle with extra sauce, sprinkle with finely chopped parsley and a touch of Parmesan.
Optional: garnish with a few sautéed mushroom slices or microgreens for elegance.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately while the ravioli is hot and the cream sauce is silky.
Pair with garlic bread or a crisp green salad.
Enjoy with a glass of dry white wine for an authentic Italian dining experience.

chefTips: Use a combination of mushrooms for depth of flavor.
Dry mushrooms slightly before filling to avoid soggy pasta.
Make pasta and filling ahead of time; assemble just before cooking.
Finish with a drizzle of truffle oil for a luxurious touch.
